messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired: p99 inference latency > 2.5s for 12m on prod-east. Auto-page to #eng-oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/latency?p=prod-east :rotating_light:
amina: ACKed :hand: I'm on it, pulling traces and recent deploys
amina: seeing a surge in tail for /v1/generate, spikes align with KV cache evictions ~ 11:02 UTC
carla: same, KV eviction count jumped. Could be hotkey. throwing a quick query to redis-hotkeys
raj: any customer-facing impact yet? SLA notices?
amina: not seeing SLO-limited customer errors, just inflated p99 and a few slow responses. letting ops know if we need to enable fallback models
sophia: reassigning traffic to dedicated pool in us-east could help buy time, want me to flip?
amina: yes please, enable route fallback for prod-east -> dedicated-pool-1 and throttle large-batches. runbook step 3 says: `route set fallback=demand-dedicated --region=prod-east`
devops-bot: autoscale request triggered: scale up dedicated-pool-1 by 4 gpus (ETA ~90s)
raj: can we limit batch size for the hot route? might reduce tail
carla: pushing a config patch to reduce max_batch_tokens from 1024 -> 512 on /v1/generate (small change)
amina: rolling patch now, will monitor. also enabling prefix KV warmup for hot keys: `kvcache --warm keys=hot:users:*`
sophia: I'm taking over if this lasts past T+20, will prepare handoff notes
amina: noted. current mitigation timeline: 00:00 page, 00:30 autoscale + route fallback, 00:45 batch cap + kv warmup. preliminary p99 dropped from 2.6s -> 1.1s after autoscale.
raj: nice. keep an eye on potential noisy retry loops from clients, can we throttle retries at edge?
carla: adding 429-on-retry-header for 120s to reduce client storms
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: acknowledged by amina, responders assigned: amina, carla. Escalation window active.
amina: if p99 holds under 1.2s for 10m and error rates stable, we'll start de-escalation and close page. otherwise sophia will rotate in
sophia: copy. prepping postmortem placeholder and customer-impact note template
devops-bot: dedicated-pool-1 scaled successfully, 4 gpus added.
amina: monitoring looks good. p95 stable, p99 trending down. tagging this thread for later follow-up (runbook edits + add matrics to dashboard). :thumbsup:
